verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a payments SaaS with SDKs, platform plugins, a dashboard and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out control. The docs cover payments, webhooks, test mode, auth scopes and the MCP server, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
